# Homzegy

> Homzegy (homzegy.com) is an independent real estate marketing platform in Egypt, run by an independent real estate marketer. It presents real estate projects with developer prices and payment plans, and helps buyers compare and book. Current projects: Somabay and Makadi Heights on the Red Sea. Homzegy is not a developer; contracts are signed directly with the developer. Prices below are from developer price lists dated October 2026 and may change.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +20 122 404 4430

## Projects

- [Somabay](https://homzegy.com/somabay/): Peninsula on the Red Sea (10M m², 11 km of beaches, 7 hotels, 3 golf courses, GEMS International School), about 40 minutes from Hurghada International Airport. 11 phases incl. Golf Town Marina Edition, Blanca Gardens, Mazeej, Baywest Valley, Mesca, Blanca, Nautilus (Bayside) and Coral Coves, Arc of Soma, Reef Town, Wadi Soma (Reefside). Units from EGP 15,900,000 on an 8-year installment plan with 5% down payment; 5-year plan is 12.5% less; cash discount up to 30% (cash from EGP 11,130,000). Annual maintenance about USD 10/m².
- [Makadi Heights](https://homzegy.com/makadi-heights/): Integrated town in Makadi Bay by Orascom Development (developer of El Gouna), 4.75M m², 78 m above sea level, about 20 minutes from Hurghada International Airport. Latest off-plan phases: Ledge Valley (lagoon chalets, from EGP 13,225,000), Aden Parks (from EGP 15,405,000), Siyal Villas (from EGP 23,585,000). Early-delivery phases: Ria, Ledge, Ledge Flare. Payment: 0%, 10% or 15% down payment over 7–8 years, 22% cash discount, delivery after 3.5 years, fully finished units.
